result.topic_en: Conditions for the image of a shortest line (geodesic) on a curved surface under a similar (conformal) mapping onto the plane, including the condition equation, the curvature of the image curve, and the two conditions for a conformal representation in the plane.

methods.what: Condition equation for a geodesic in conformal plane coordinates (x,y) with linear magnification factor n
Curvature radius of the planar image of a geodesic under a conformal map, in terms of the normal derivative of log n
Conditions for a conformal (similar-in-the-small) representation of a surface on the plane: equal scale in x and y directions and orthogonality
Struck-out determinant-type form of the geodesic condition using second derivatives of the coordinates
